events.title: Kotlin 2.0 released
events.summary: JetBrains shipped Kotlin 2.0 on May 21, 2024 with the K2 compiler — faster builds, better multiplatform support, and improved Java interop.
events.about: The K2 compiler rewrote Kotlin's frontend for speed and consistency across JVM, JS, Native, and Wasm targets. Kotlin 2 unified Compose Multiplatform and server-side Kotlin under one toolchain — important for Android teams sharing code with iOS and backend services.

narrative.whyChosen: Kotlin 2 was a compiler reboot, not just another feature release.
narrative.whyImportant: Faster analysis and multiplatform parity kept Kotlin competitive with Swift and TypeScript.
narrative.problemSolved: The old compiler struggled with large Gradle projects and divergent platform backends.

events.title: OpenAI GPT-4o released
events.summary: OpenAI released GPT-4o on May 13, 2024 — a faster, cheaper multimodal model with native audio, vision, and text in one model.
events.about: GPT-4o ('o' for omni) unified text, image, and voice in a single endpoint — powering ChatGPT's voice mode and real-time translation demos. It matched GPT-4 Turbo quality at half the latency, resetting expectations for interactive AI apps.

narrative.whyChosen: GPT-4o made multimodal, low-latency AI the default consumer experience.
narrative.whyImportant: Native audio and vision in one model simplified product architecture for AI apps.
narrative.problemSolved: Separate models for text, vision, and speech added latency, cost, and integration complexity.
